# External environment dependencies required

The test suite requires a reachable Postgres (checked by _db_available and used directly), the tree_sitter_python package (importorskip), and a functioning git CLI (subprocess git calls). If any of these are absent or misconfigured the integration tests are skipped or will fail, making the tests environment-sensitive.
